issues.name: Other access complaints
issues.definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

issues.name: Forced Shuffle on Free Tier
issues.definition: Free users are unable to directly choose and play a specific song because playback is forced into shuffle or a playlist.

issues.name: Free-Tier Skip Limit
issues.definition: Free users are restricted to a limited number of skips, preventing them from skipping songs as needed.

issues.name: Premium-Gated Playback Controls
issues.definition: Basic playback controls such as playing the next or previous song, queueing tracks, or seeking within a song are unavailable without Premium.

issues.name: Other billing complaints
issues.definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

issues.name: Other catalog complaints
issues.definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)

issues.name: Other downloads complaints
issues.definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

issues.name: Update degraded app experience
issues.definition: Complaints that a recent update made the app worse, disappointing, or unusable belong here.

issues.name: Excessive app restrictions
issues.definition: Complaints that restrictions in the app are too limiting belong here.

issues.name: Rude customer support
issues.definition: Complaints that Spotify app support staff behave rudely belong here.

issues.name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
issues.definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

issues.name: Other playback complaints
issues.definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

issues.name: Excessive Ad Interruptions
issues.definition: Free listening is interrupted by ads too frequently or with disruptive volume, making continuous music playback difficult.

issues.name: Missing Playback Controls
issues.definition: Updates remove or restrict controls such as seeking, repeating, or playing a specific part of a song.

issues.name: Unwanted Random Playlist Playback
issues.definition: Playlist playback is shuffled or randomized when listeners expect songs to play in their chosen order.

issues.name: Disruptive Home Screen Changes
issues.definition: Home screen redesigns and automatically playing interface elements make browsing difficult or lack clear controls to disable them.

issues.name: Other usability complaints
issues.definition: usability complaints that fit none of the specific usability issues (Navigation, controls, layout, UI changes, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions (e.g. 'new home screen is confusing', 'too many ads between songs').)
